detailed_descriptions_html.en:
A day at the warehouse

Your first day at Bob Company. Check orders on your tablet, find the right items on the shelves, and carry them to the packing station. As you complete orders and clear the shelves, you will settle into a working rhythm of your own.

There is no need to rush. Work at your own pace, without a time limit. Items packed by mistake return to where they belong. Buy a cleaning robot, and you can leave it to tidy up goods dropped on the floor, too.

A warehouse that gets easier

Spend the points you earn from deliveries on equipment and upgrades. The boxes you first carried by hand can go on a cart, be gathered with a powered vacuum, or be delivered by drones. With more tools, you gain new ways to handle the same orders.

Ship all the goods in the warehouse to earn a promotion and open a new work area. As you rise from Intern to Director, the shelves fill with an ever wider range of products, from groceries to game consoles, furniture, and robots. Carry more, ship with less effort, and enjoy watching your working day change.

What comes with a promotion

Work and equipment are not the only things that grow at Bob Company. As you move up the ranks, you will discover new sides of the company and the stories behind them.

Slow down between deliveries and take a look around. Things you once passed without a thought may start to look different. How much you learn about the company's secrets is up to your curiosity.

Features

  • A single-player, first-person warehouse sim at your own pace
  • Relaxed order fulfillment with no time limits or game over
  • Equipment upgrades and automation, from your hands to carts, powered vacuums, and drones
  • Five ranks from Intern to Director, with expanding work areas
  • The satisfaction of finding, carrying, and shipping 432 different products
  • Company secrets and stories that gradually emerge through promotions and exploration
